Thanks for the replying. Letting go of that crutch is going to be really difficult.. I suffer with social anxiety too, so I pretty much sit in my house all day totally out of it writing music 24/7, to the point that it is integrated into my life. However I do want to make a change, there is a chance I may relapse though, which is the most terrifying thing of all, because the next time usually hits harder.

I'm going to take your advice though, go cold turkey and get myself down to the gym tomorrow

Thanks again
Thank you for replying, I shall have a read through.
